description: Lima latar hero mahasiswa SATU dalam satu keluarga visual biru, ivory dan oranye.
method: imagegen bawaan, satu pemanggilan per latar, stylized-concept
alt_purpose: Dekoratif. Alt kosong, aria-hidden, tidak memuat teks, kontrol, data atau maskot.
scope: Hero daftar menu mahasiswa. Beranda pending mempertahankan panorama sebelumnya. Latar Peringkat tersedia juga untuk pembacaan kelompok admin tanpa perubahan izin.

optimization.method: Pillow, resize LANCZOS dan konversi RGB WebP quality 88 method 6
optimization.note: Master tidak diedit; hanya resize dan kompresi runtime.

assets.purpose: Halaman kampus ilustratif untuk Beranda, bukan foto UTY.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Decorative panoramic background plate for an existing compact SATU student dashboard hero, NOT a website mockup.
Style: refined softly dimensional paper architecture, matte ivory and pale sky-blue material, delicate bevels, convincing soft ambient light, elegant and restrained editorial art. SATU palette white #FFFFFF, sky #E7F2FF, blue #1764E8 used sparingly, small warm orange #FFB85C details. Crisp high-resolution landscape approximately 3:1, 2400 by 800.
Composition: the LEFT 58 percent is nearly white/pale icy blue and intentionally empty for real HTML text and buttons. All architectural detail occupies the RIGHT 42 percent and outer lower edge, with low contrast in its central-right area because an existing separate bird mascot will be composited there by the app. Soft continuous transition, not a hard rectangle. No artificial vignette.
Absolutely NO bird, mascot, character, people, text, letters, numerals, watermark, logo, badges, checkmarks, progress indicator, statistics, charts, app UI, floating interface cards, user work or trophies. Do not draw a mascot platform or a central pedestal. This is only an atmospheric backdrop, not information. Use a SMALL number of large meaningful forms, no clutter, no confetti, no sparkles, no noisy small decorative items.
Scene: An open university courtyard in a contemporary Indonesian campus, abstract and fictional rather than a particular real building. On the far right, pale-blue colonnades, a broad curved ivory arch, low distant academic facade and one very soft tree silhouette. Airy morning sky, flowing sunlit courtyard lines across the lower-right, and a subtle warm orange sunlit edge. Architecture reads as campus at a glance but stays secondary. The left side is a clean sunlit ivory wall dissolving into the sky.
